# Sidebar

Vertical navigation shell. Compose persistent destinations with `NavigationItem` inside the `navigation` slot, and place workspace, tools, or account surfaces through the named `header`, `tools`, and `footer` slots.

- **Import:** `import { Sidebar } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/navigation-sidebar--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import {
  Home01 as Home,
  SearchMd as Search,
  Settings01 as Settings,
  User01 as User,
} from "@kozmos-ds/icons";
import { NavigationItem, Sidebar, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function SidebarExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div className="flex h-96 border">
        <Sidebar
          footer={
            <NavigationItem icon={<User className="h-5 w-5" />}>
              Account
            </NavigationItem>
          }
          header={<div className="font-bold text-xl">Workspace</div>}
          navigation={
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <NavigationItem icon={<Home className="h-5 w-5" />} selected>
                Overview
              </NavigationItem>
              <NavigationItem icon={<Search className="h-5 w-5" />}>
                Explore
              </NavigationItem>
              <NavigationItem icon={<Settings className="h-5 w-5" />}>
                Settings
              </NavigationItem>
            </div>
          }
        />
        <div className="flex-1 p-4 bg-muted/20">Content Area</div>
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Sidebar

It forwards its ref to `HTMLElement`. Its props are `SidebarProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, "content">`.

- `collapsed`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.
- `collapsible`: `boolean`, optional.
- `header`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `navigation`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `content`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `tools`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `footer`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `variant`: `"expanded" | "rail"`, optional, default `collapsed ? "rail" : "expanded"`.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
